description: How the numbers are worked out and what each means, following Cheiro (d. 1936), public domain in India.

items.text: How these numbers are worked out

translations.en: Your psychic number (mulank) is the day of the month you were born, reduced to a single digit. Your destiny number (bhagyank) is the full date, reduced the same way. Your name number is the sum of the letters of your name, reduced.
translations.hi: Your psychic number (mulank) is the day of the month you were born, reduced to a single digit. Your destiny number (bhagyank) is the full date, reduced the same way. Your name number is the sum of the letters of your name, reduced.

items.summary_1line: The arithmetic behind numerology, and the three numbers that matter
items.summary_2to3line: Your psychic number (mulank) is the day of the month you were born, reduced to a single digit. Your destiny number (bhagyank) is the full date, reduced the same way. Your name number is the sum of the letters of your name, reduced.
items.bodh_3to4line: Reduction means adding the digits until one digit remains: 29 becomes 2+9 = 11, and 11 becomes 1+1 = 2. Cheiro used a fixed letter table (A=1, B=2, ... I=1, J=1, K=2 ...). Nothing here is a judgement about you - it is arithmetic on a date and a name, and the interpretation on top of it is Cheiro's, not a fact.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 1 to the Sun: the person is meant to lead rather than follow, is original and ambitious, but must avoid arrogance and domineering.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 1 to the Sun: the person is meant to lead rather than follow, is original and ambitious, but must avoid arrogance and domineering.

items.summary_1line: Leadership, originality, ambition. A number of self-direction.
items.summary_2to3line: Cheiro gives 1 to the Sun: the person is meant to lead rather than follow, is original and ambitious, but must avoid arrogance and domineering.
items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Sunday and Monday. Colours: gold, orange, yellow. Cheiro pairs 1 with 4, 2 with 7, and 3, 6 and 9 with each other as friendly numbers. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 2 to the Moon: imaginative, gentle and adaptable, but easily affected by moods and by the opinions of others.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 2 to the Moon: imaginative, gentle and adaptable, but easily affected by moods and by the opinions of others.

items.summary_1line: Sensitivity, imagination, changeability. A number of feeling.
items.summary_2to3line: Cheiro gives 2 to the Moon: imaginative, gentle and adaptable, but easily affected by moods and by the opinions of others.
items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Monday and Friday. Colours: cream, pale green, white. Cheiro regards 2 and 7 as closely related. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 3 to Jupiter: the planner and the administrator, strong on discipline and system, sometimes rigid and inclined to instruct others.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 3 to Jupiter: the planner and the administrator, strong on discipline and system, sometimes rigid and inclined to instruct others.

items.summary_1line: Discipline, planning, authority. A number of order.
items.summary_2to3line: Cheiro gives 3 to Jupiter: the planner and the administrator, strong on discipline and system, sometimes rigid and inclined to instruct others.
items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Thursday, Tuesday, Friday. Colours: mauve, violet, purple. Cheiro groups 3 with 6 and 9 as mutually friendly. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro, writing in a period when Uranus had just entered popular use, assigns 4 to it: the number of the unconventional, of sudden reversals and of things done differently.
translations.hi: Cheiro, writing in a period when Uranus had just entered popular use, assigns 4 to it: the number of the unconventional, of sudden reversals and of things done differently.

items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Saturday and Sunday. Colours: grey and electric blue. Cheiro pairs 4 with 1 and 8. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 5 to Mercury: fast, adaptable, good with words and trade, fond of travel and change, but easily scattered.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 5 to Mercury: fast, adaptable, good with words and trade, fond of travel and change, but easily scattered.

items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Wednesday and Friday. Colours: light grey, white, silver. 5 is the most changeable of Cheiro's numbers. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 6 to Venus: affection, attractiveness and domestic comfort, but also duty towards family and a tendency to over-attach.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 6 to Venus: affection, attractiveness and domestic comfort, but also duty towards family and a tendency to over-attach.

items.summary_1line: Love, beauty, comfort, and responsibility for others.
items.summary_2to3line: Cheiro gives 6 to Venus: affection, attractiveness and domestic comfort, but also duty towards family and a tendency to over-attach.
items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Friday, Tuesday, Thursday. Colours: pink, light blue, turquoise. Cheiro groups 6 with 3 and 9. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro assigns 7 to Neptune, linked with the Moon: the dreamer and the thinker, drawn to the unseen, often happiest alone.
translations.hi: Cheiro assigns 7 to Neptune, linked with the Moon: the dreamer and the thinker, drawn to the unseen, often happiest alone.

items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Monday and Sunday. Colours: sea green, pale yellow, white. Cheiro pairs 7 with 2. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 8 to Saturn: the hardest of the numbers in his reading, promising solid results but only after delay, discipline and often loss first.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 8 to Saturn: the hardest of the numbers in his reading, promising solid results but only after delay, discipline and often loss first.

items.summary_1line: Discipline, material weight, delay then reward.

items.bodh_3to4line: Days: Saturday, Friday, Monday. Colours: black, dark blue, grey. Cheiro warns 8 pairs badly with 4. Source: Cheiro, Book of Numbers.

translations.en: Cheiro gives 9 to Mars: energy and courage, capacity for hard achievement, but a tendency to conflict and to act before thinking.
translations.hi: Cheiro gives 9 to Mars: energy and courage, capacity for hard achievement, but a tendency to conflict and to act before thinking.

items.summary_1line: Force, courage, conflict, and achievement through struggle.
